ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels is approximately 40:60 across the total visible fluke surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: Contiguous high-intensity central region bounded by low-intensity marginal mottling along the trailing edge. Right lobe: Dominant low-intensity field with sparse, high-contrast linear and flecked white clusters throughout the central and distal zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical U-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 35-40 degrees at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 5-15 pixels; most concentrated and jagged on the distal thirds of both trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary trailing edge boundary follows a convex curve from the median notch, terminating in upward-swept, pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of circular, high-intensity pixel groups (diameters 5-12 pixels) located at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast linear disruptions; prominent vertical dark mark on the inner left lobe and several sets of parallel white linear marks (rake marks) on the lower-central and distal right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive parallel linear rake marks across the ventral surface of the right lobe; prominent rosette scarring from barnacle colonization on both fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Extreme pigmentation asymmetry between the predominantly white left lobe and the predominantly black right lobe.
